name: Terra Almanac
tagline: The living record of every acre you steward.
positioning: Terra Almanac turns raw soil samples into a decisive field playbook, so owner-operators can farm the next decade instead of the last one.

hero.h1: Know your ground before it decides your season.
hero.sub: Terra Almanac reads your soil the way a great agronomist would — sample by sample, block by block — and hands you a clear plan for what to plant, amend, and protect this year.

features.title: From lab report to field plan
features.description: Drop in a raw lab PDF and Terra Almanac translates nitrogen, pH, and organic matter into a plain-language plan for each block — no agronomy degree required.

features.title: The almanac that remembers
features.description: Every sample, amendment, and yield builds a permanent record per acre, so you finally see how last year's decisions moved this year's dirt.

features.title: Amendment math, done for you
features.description: Enter your target and Terra Almanac calculates lime, compost, and fertilizer rates by block, with cost per acre before you spend a dollar.

features.title: Moisture and season windows
features.description: Pair soil texture with local weather to catch the exact planting and tillage windows for each field, pushed to your phone.

features.title: Zones that pay for themselves
features.description: Variable-rate zones drawn straight from your sample grid, exportable to any spreader or planter monitor.

features.title: Share with your crew
features.description: Give your operator, agronomist, and lender their own seat with the right level of access — one source of ground truth for everyone.

testimonials.quote: I stopped guessing at lime rates across forty blocks. Terra Almanac told me which three fields were actually starving my beans, and my yield map proved it by fall.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Florek

testimonials.quote: We used to keep soil history in a shoebox of lab printouts. Now every acre has a page, and I can hand my agronomist a login instead of a phone call.
testimonials.name: Renata Bishop

testimonials.quote: The amendment cost projections paid for the subscription in one spring. I saw exactly where compost beat synthetic before I ordered a single ton.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ade

pricing.blurb: For the single operator who wants their ground on record.
For working farms with a crew and an agronomist on speed dial.
For multi-farm operations and cooperatives managing many books.

homepage.footerBlurb: Terra Almanac keeps the permanent record of your soil — so every acre you steward gets smarter, season after season.
